_meta._comment_retention: ^^^ THE ONE RETENTION KNOB. Change this number and nothing else. bootstrap.py reads _meta.RETENTION_DAYS and writes it into policy.phases.delete.min_age before the PUT, so the two can never drift. Plan I-4 is UNANSWERED: 90d is a discretionary default, not a compliance number.
_meta._comment_put: This top-level _meta block is NOT part of the ILM API body; _ilm/policy accepts only the 'policy' key. bootstrap.py strips it. To PUT by hand: jq '{policy}' ilm-apiaudit.json | curl ... -d @- (see infra/README.md).
_meta._comment_cold: The cold phase is only valid on a cluster that actually has cold-tier nodes (data_cold role). On a cluster without them, ILM parks the index in 'check-migration' forever. Set COLD_TIER_EXISTS = False in bootstrap.py's config block and the cold phase is stripped from the policy before the PUT; warm then runs straight into delete.
_meta._comment_sizing: Rollover at 50 GB primary / 7 d. Per plan §5 (~0.6 KB/doc on ES disk before replication): 50 GB is ~2.5 d of primaries at 200 rps, ~10 d at 50 rps, ~50 d at 10 rps — so at 10 and 50 rps the 7 d max_age is what actually fires.
